normalizedBrief.topic: A student launches a startup after failing several times.

title: The Hidden Failures
hook: Everyone celebrates the first success. Nobody sees the failures before it.

storyArc.setup: Arjun struggles in his hostel room.
storyArc.escalation: He rebuilds his prototype in the lab.

scenes.action: Arjun looking stressed over a failed prototype.
scenes.lighting: Dim desk lamp lighting his face
scenes.visualPrompt: Medium close up of a 21-year-old student with short black hair and a navy hoodie, looking stressed over a circuit board on a desk in a dark room lit only by a desk lamp. Cinematic style.

scenes.action: Arjun looking at a laptop screen, sighing.
scenes.visualPrompt: Over the shoulder shot of a student in a navy hoodie looking at a laptop screen. The screen glows blue.
scenes.voiceover: Nobody sees the failures before it.

scenes.action: Arjun actively soldering and rebuilding the prototype.
scenes.camera: Close up on hands and face
scenes.visualPrompt: Close up of a young student in a navy hoodie soldering a circuit board in a brightly lit lab.

scenes.action: Arjun presenting his working prototype excitedly.
scenes.visualPrompt: Wide shot of a student in a navy hoodie presenting a device in a sunlit room, looking excited.

scenes.action: Arjun shaking hands with a person off-camera.
scenes.visualPrompt: Medium shot of a student in a navy hoodie shaking hands with someone in a sunlit room.
scenes.voiceover: Until you find the one person who says yes.

scenes.action: Arjun looking confidently at the camera.
scenes.visualPrompt: Close up of a confident young student in a navy hoodie looking directly at the camera in a sunlit room.
